texts.· esta vez la rueda no da nada: ·  the wheel gives nothing this time
texts.%s sube dos niveles por %d de oro, el pr: %s rises two levels for %d gold, the price of one. You have %d gold.
texts.%s · %s. Su fuerza depende de la rareza: %s · %s. Its strength depends on rarity and level.
texts.+0,04 s de parada perfecta por nivel: +0.04 s of perfect parry per level
texts.+0,25 s de punto débil y +0,2× a su golp: +0.25 s of weak point and +0.2× to its hit per level
texts.+0,5× al contraataque de la parada por n: +0.5× to the parry riposte per level
texts.+10% de oro y ascuas errantes más a menu: +10% gold and wandering embers more often. −10% health.
texts.+10% de vida y parada perfecta 0,1 s más: +10% health and a perfect parry 0.1 s longer. Her clicks deal 15% less.
texts.+2 al daño por clic y +8% a todo tu daño: +2 click damage and +8% to all your damage
texts.Acertar el punto débil de un élite o un: Hitting an elite's or a boss's weak point brings Flare 3 s closer.
texts.Al bloquear devuelves el doble del daño: When you block, you return twice the damage that gets through.
texts.Al caer o retirarte conservas las ascuas: When you fall or retreat you keep your embers. At the bonfire you buy permanent upgrades and come back stronger.
texts.Al conseguir ciertos logros se desbloque: Some achievements unlock new BEARERS: the Sentinel, the Summoner and the Wanderer. Each changes their stats and what Flare does. Choose them at the bonfire.
texts.Apuesta %d de oro y gira. Los diez secto: Bet %d gold and spin. The ten sectors are equal: each comes up one time in ten. You have %d gold.
Bet gold and spin: prizes… or nothing.
texts.Ardiente: sus golpes queman 3 s · párale: Burning: its blows burn for 3 s · parry it
texts.Ascua errante · ¡Furia! Doble daño de cl: Wandering ember · Fury! Double click damage for 12 s
texts.Ascuas: se conservan al caer o retirarte: Embers: you keep them when you fall or retreat. Spend them at the bonfire.
texts.Atrapa las ascuas errantes que cruzan el: Catch the wandering embers that cross the stage: gold, fury, health or an instant Flare.
texts.Aún no tienes piezas. Los jefes siempre: You have no pieces yet. Bosses always leave one; elites and chests sometimes do.
texts.CLIC/ESPACIO atacar E destello R par: CLICK/SPACE attack   E flare   R parry   1-4 forge   Q amount   ESC menu
texts.Cada 10.º golpe de una cadena hace el tr: Every 10th hit of a chain deals triple damage
texts.Cada Destello deja además oro: un tercio: Each Flare also leaves gold: a third of the chamber's victory.
texts.Cada camino recorre cuatro cámaras y ter: Each path crosses four chambers and ends at %s. Hover over an icon to see what it holds; every chamber has a fight.
texts.Cada caída deja una brasa. Lo que aprend: Every fall leaves an ember. What you learned in the eclipse comes back with you.
texts.Cada cinco cámaras eliges una reliquia y: Every five chambers you choose a relic and a path on the map: rests, elites, chests, merchants, altars or the Eclipse Wheel. The fight waits for your decision. Click the chamber bar to see the map again.
Each chest holds one more reward.
texts.Cada crítico manual que impacta reduce 0: Each manual critical that lands cuts Flare's recharge by 0.4 s.
texts.Cada parada perfecta te cura un 5% de tu: Each perfect parry heals 5% of your max health.
texts.Cada portador cambia algunas estadística: Each bearer changes some stats and adds an effect to Flare. The chosen one sets out on the next expedition.
texts.Cada tercer ataque prepara su Brasa. Int: Every third attack readies its Ember. Interrupt it with Flare.
texts.Cada tercer ataque se cubre con una cora: Every third attack it dons molten armour. Break it before it pours; Flare hits it harder.
texts.Calor: +25% de oro, pero los enemigos go: Heat: +25% gold, but enemies hit 15% harder.
texts.Cambia vida por daño durante la expedici: Trades health for damage for the expedition.
texts.Canaliza durante tres segundos. Destello: Channels for three seconds. Flare cancels its attack.
texts.Clic para ver el mapa del tramo: Click to see the map of this stretch
texts.Clics y cadenas · nace de Brasa interior: Clicks and chains · grows from Inner Ember
Land Gold ×3 on the Eclipse Wheel.
texts.Coraza fundida: rómpela a golpes · Deste: Molten armour: break it with blows · Flare ×1.5
texts.Cuando brille un PUNTO DÉBIL dorado sobr: When a golden WEAK POINT shines on the enemy, click on it: a sure critical and Flare sooner. Space can't reach it.
texts.Cuatro impactos rompen su escudo. Destel: Four hits break its shield. Flare breaks it at once.
Heals for free before the fight.
texts.Cámara %d de %s. Tu progreso se guarda a: Chamber %d of %s. Your progress saves automatically.
texts.DESTELLO [E] golpea por ocho. Rompe el e: FLARE [E] hits for eight. It breaks the Guardian's shield, interrupts the King's and the Acolyte's charges and cracks the Forgemaster's armour.
texts.Derrota a la Campanera Vacía, jefa de la: Defeat the Hollow Bellringer, boss of the Crypts.
texts.Derrota a un jefe sin atacar con clic du: Defeat a boss without clicking during the fight.
texts.Derrota a un jefe sin recibir daño en es: Defeat a boss without taking damage in that fight.
Rests and shrines heal half as much.
texts.Descansos, santuarios y la fragua para l: Rests, shrines and the forge to arrive in one piece.
texts.Destello invoca además tres luceros dura: Flare also summons three wisps for 8 seconds.
texts.Destello levanta además un muro que abso: Flare also raises a wall that absorbs damage (25% of her health) for 6 seconds.
texts.Destello recarga un 15% más rápido y gol: Flare recharges 15% faster and hits 15% harder.
texts.Destello recarga un 20% más rápido y gol: Flare recharges 20% faster and hits 25% harder.
texts.Destello: rompe escudos, interrumpe los: Flare: breaks shields, interrupts channelled attacks and hits the Forgemaster's armour ×1.5.
texts.Duelo ganado · el rival deja una pieza d: Duel won · the rival leaves a piece for the Arsenal
texts.EL ECO TE OFRECE UN PACTO: THE ECHO OFFERS YOU A PACT
texts.Eclipse %d de %d desbloqueados. Pulsa pa: Eclipse %d of %d unlocked. Press to change.
texts.Eclipse %d desbloqueado · elígelo en la: Eclipse %d unlocked · choose it at the bonfire
texts.Eco: si pasas 2 s sin atacar con clic o: Echo: after 2 s without clicking or Space, enemies heal.
texts.El bloqueo detiene un 5% más del golpe p: Blocking stops 5% more of the blow per level
texts.El combate está detenido. Puedes decidir: Combat is paused. Take your time.
texts.El eclipse devoró el mundo. Tú llevas la: The eclipse devoured the world. You carry the last spark.
texts.Elige una pieza para ver sus detalles, e: Pick a piece to see its details, equip it, upgrade it or salvage it.
texts.Empieza con un lucero más y sus luceros: Starts with one more wisp and her wisps deal 30% more. Her clicks deal 20% less.
texts.Empiezas cada viaje con un lucero más: Start each journey with one more wisp
texts.Empiezas con un lucero que ataca solo. C: You start with a wisp that attacks on its own. Buy more at the forge; clicks speed up the fight. Use Q to buy ×10 or as many as you can.
texts.Encuéntralo en tus expediciones para con: Find it on your expeditions to learn about it.
texts.Entrega %d de vida actual para ganar +20: Give %d of your current health to gain +20%% click and wisp damage for this expedition. Pacts stack. You must survive the payment.
texts.Equipa una pieza del arsenal: Equip a piece from the arsenal
texts.Espinosa: tus clics te hieren · usa luce: Thorny: your clicks hurt you · use wisps
texts.Golpea por ocho, interrumpe cargas y rom: Hits for eight, interrupts charges and breaks shields.
texts.Guardarás %d ascuas. Terminará esta expe: You'll keep %d embers. This expedition will end: you lose the gold, the forge and the relics of the journey.
texts.Haz clic o mantén ESPACIO para atacar si: Click or hold SPACE to attack without pressing again and again. Top pace: one blow every 0.3 s. Chaining them adds up to 30% damage.
texts.Interrumpir una canalización con Destell: Interrupting a channel with Flare cuts its next recharge by 25%.
texts.LOS LUCEROS VELARON POR TI: THE WISPS KEPT WATCH FOR YOU
texts.La brasa se niega a apagarse · Destello: The ember refuses to die · Flare ready
texts.La expedición actual terminará en la cám: The current expedition will end in chamber %d. You keep the %d embers you carry; the gold, the forge and the relics are lost.
texts.La parada perfecta aturde 0,6 s más y el: A perfect parry stuns 0.6 s longer and blocking stops 15% more.
The perfect parry lasts 0.1 s longer.
texts.Las ascuas errantes aparecen el doble de: Wandering embers appear twice as often.
texts.Las piezas se conservan al caer. Puedes: Pieces are kept when you fall. You can change them any time from the pause menu or the bonfire.
texts.Las ruinas guardan silencio. Sin efectos: The ruins keep silent. No special rules.
texts.Llamada del enjambre · tres luceros acud: Call of the Swarm · three wisps answer
texts.Los jefes, algunos élites y los cofres d: Bosses, some elites and chests leave pieces of gear that you keep when you fall. Equip them, upgrade them with shards and buy masteries in the ARSENAL (pause menu or bonfire).
texts.Los puntos débiles aparecen el doble de: Weak points appear twice as often.
texts.Los puntos débiles aparecen un 40% más a: Weak points appear 40% more often and last 1 s longer.
texts.Mejor cámara: %d · Expediciones: %d: Best chamber: %d   ·   Expeditions: %d   ·   Enemies defeated: %d   ·   Bosses defeated: %d
texts.Mejoras permanentes de tus técnicas. Se: Permanent upgrades to your techniques. They cost shards, which come from salvaging pieces, from bosses and from some chests.
texts.Mercaderes, altares, la fragua y la Rued: Merchants, altars, the forge and the Eclipse Wheel.
texts.Muro de brasas · el golpe no te alcanza: Ember Wall · the blow doesn't reach you
The save could not be completed.
The game could not be saved.
texts.No se pudo guardar. Comprueba el espacio: Could not save. Check the free space; quit again to close without saving.
texts.No se pudo leer la partida guardada. Se: The saved game could not be read. A copy was kept:
texts.Oro de esta expedición. Gástalo en la fo: This expedition's gold. Spend it at the forge.
texts.PARADA [R] o clic derecho: alza la guard: PARRY [R] or right click: raise your guard when the blow bar enters the blue zone. At the last instant (bright zone) it is a perfect parry: no damage, the enemy stunned and a riposte. Too early you only block half; if nothing comes, the guard takes time to recharge.
texts.PUNTO DÉBIL · haz clic en el brillo do: WEAK POINT  ·  click the golden glow
texts.Parada [R] o clic derecho: alza la guard: Parry [R] or right click: raise your guard just before a blow. Right on time (bright zone) is a perfect parry: the blow deals no damage, the enemy is stunned and you riposte. Too early you only block half. Bosses and charged attacks are never fully cancelled.
texts.Parada parcial · el golpe cargado pierde: Partial parry · the charged blow loses %d%%
Take it off before salvaging it.
texts.RETOS Y COLECCIÓN: retos diarios y seman: CHALLENGES AND COLLECTION: daily and weekly challenges, achievements and complete collections give you embers and shards. A number next to the button shows rewards to claim.
texts.Recupera hasta un %d%% de tu vida máxima: Recover up to %d%% of your max health, for free.
texts.Recuperas 4 de vida al vencer a un enemi: You recover 4 health when you defeat an enemy.
texts.Recuperas un 0,5% de tu vida máxima por: You recover 0.5% of your max health per second.
texts.Recuperas vida al llegar y el rival nunc: You recover health on arrival and the rival is never an elite.
texts.Recuperas vida antes del combate: You recover health before the fight
texts.Refugio de musgo · protege del 40% del g: Moss Shelter · guards against 40% of the blow
texts.Retos del día y de la semana: los mismos: The day's and the week's challenges: the same for everyone. They progress as you play; claim the reward before they renew.
texts.Retos diarios y semanales, logros con re: Daily and weekly challenges, achievements with rewards, your discoveries and what you've played.
texts.Rival élite: ×2,2 vida y ×1,3 daño. Paga: Elite rival: ×2.2 health and ×1.3 damage. Pays ×2.5 gold and one more ember.
texts.Rómpela antes de que se vierta · Destell: Break it before it pours · Flare ×1.5
Sets out on the next expedition.
texts.Silencio castiga los ataques manuales; T: Silence punishes manual attacks; Death Knell is interrupted with Flare.
No modifiers and no extra reward.
texts.Sube dos niveles de una mejora de forja: Raises a forge upgrade two levels for the price of one.
Raise a mastery to its maximum level.
Raise a piece to its maximum level.
texts.Suelta clic / Espacio · luceros seguros: Release click / Space · wisps are safe
texts.Supera la cámara 30 en Eclipse 1 o super: Clear chamber 30 on Eclipse 1 or higher.
texts.Termina la expedición y conserva tus asc: Ends the expedition and keeps your embers.
texts.Tras 2 s sin atacar manualmente, los luc: After 2 s without manual attacks, wisps deal 30% more damage. Flare doesn't break the choir.
texts.Tu primera reliquia espera al superar la: Your first relic awaits past chamber 5.
texts.Tus críticos manuales curan un 1% de tu: Your manual criticals heal 1% of your max health.
texts.Tus expediciones terminadas aparecerán a: Your finished expeditions will appear here.
texts.Tus luceros reunieron %d de oro durante: Your wisps gathered %d gold while you were away.
texts.Tus luceros reúnen 2 de oro por minuto y: Your wisps gather 2 gold per minute per wisp while you're away (up to 4 hours). The expedition takes no damage while the game is closed.
texts.Un 30% de los cofres sube un nivel de ca: 30% of chests rise one quality level.
texts.Un clic enciende la llama. Cada caída la: A click lights the flame. Every fall makes it eternal.
texts.Un cofre antes del combate: oro, ascuas,: A chest before the fight: gold, embers, wisps, forge or a relic.
texts.Un espíritu errante; cambia de aspecto e: A wandering spirit; it changes its look between biomes.
texts.Un lucero adicional por %d de oro (20%%: One more wisp for %d gold (20%% less than at the forge). You have %d gold.
texts.Un lucero más al empezar y ataques un 25: One more wisp at the start and attacks 25% faster; your clicks deal 10% less
texts.Un élite con dos afijos. Vencerlo te da: An elite with two affixes. Defeating it gives you a piece for the Arsenal.
texts.Una criatura de las ruinas que ataca con: A creature of the ruins that attacks by ramming.
texts.Una de estas bendiciones te acompañará d: One of these blessings will go with you for this expedition. Keys 1 · 2 · 3.
texts.Una nueva expedición. Tu legado permanec: A new expedition. Your legacy remains.
texts.Una vez por viaje, un golpe mortal te de: Once per journey, a deadly blow leaves you at 30% health, recharges Flare and unleashes fury
texts.Vampírica: se cura al golpearte: Vampiric: heals when it hits you
texts.Vencer a un enemigo protege del 40% del: Defeating an enemy guards against 40% of the next blow you take. Charges don't stack.
Sells a wisp cheaper than the forge.
texts.¡Escudo roto! El Guardián recibe daño co: Shield broken! The Guardian takes full damage.
texts.«Cada caída deja una brasa. Aliméntala y: “Every fall leaves an ember. Feed it and you will go further.”
texts.«Cada tercer golpe prepara su Brasa. Gua: “Every third blow readies his Ember. Save your Flare for that moment.”
texts.«Cuando la campana calle, calla tu espad: “When the bell falls silent, silence your sword. When it tolls, Flare.”
“The Forgemaster dresses in molten metal. Break it before it pours.”
texts.«El Rey no teme a tu espada. Teme al Des: “The King does not fear your sword. He fears the Flare that interrupts him.”
texts.«En las criptas, el eco cura a quien no: “In the crypts, the echo heals whoever your own hand does not strike.”
texts.«La forja paga bien su calor. Pero quema: “The forge pays well for its heat. But it burns.”
texts.«Las ascuas errantes no esperan. Atrápal: “Wandering embers do not wait. Catch them before they go out.”
texts.«Los luceros recuerdan a quien los liber: “The wisps remember who set them free. Take them with you.”
texts.«Su coraza fundida dura tres segundos. R: “His molten armour lasts three seconds. Break it before it pours.”
texts.Élites, duelos y cofres: más peligro, má: Elites, duels and chests: more danger, more loot.
texts.Último aliento · la brasa se niega a apa: Last Breath · the ember refuses to die. Flare ready and fury
